newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gines Navarro-OCP merger to have 50 pct freefloat.
newsitem.headline: Gines Navarro-OCP merger to have 50 pct freefloat.

text.p: Spanish building firms Gines Navarro and OCP Construcciones said on Friday the new firm resulting from their merger will have a 50 percent freefloat.
At the beginning of June the two groups announced a merger which is due to take place in the next six months.
Terms of the merger are one OCP share for three Gines.

Main shareholders will be the current owners of OCP, Florentino Perez and Mercapital with a holding of around 27 percent in the new group, while the March group (owner of Gines-Navarro) will have another 23 percent, a spokesman told Reuters after Thursday's shareholders meeting of both companies.
From January through May, Gines had net profit of 1.07 billion pesetas, 22 percent higher than the same period one year ago, on turnover of 46.21 billion pesetas, up 29 percent, the spokesman said.
In the same period OCP had gross profit of 5.5 billion pesetas.
